answer: A payout is split which means 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The vine schedule is applied in spiral and echo reveals each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4785 identities would post 4073 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
